description: SAN, NAS, object storage, and backup systems — capacity trends, latency, IOPS, and backup job monitoring.
name: Storage & Backup
quickFacts: Install vendor TAs (NetApp, Pure Storage, etc.) and configure REST API or syslog collection.

useCases.title: Volume Capacity Trending
useCases.value: Prevents application outages caused by full volumes. Enables proactive capacity planning and procurement.

useCases.title: Storage Latency Monitoring
useCases.value: High storage latency directly impacts application performance. Early detection prevents SLA breaches and user experience degradation.

useCases.title: IOPS Trending per Volume
useCases.value: Identifies workload hotspots and enables data placement optimization. Supports capacity planning for storage refreshes.

useCases.title: Disk Failure Alerts
useCases.value: Immediate awareness of disk failures allows replacement before RAID degradation leads to data loss.

useCases.title: Replication Lag Monitoring
useCases.value: Replication lag directly impacts RPO. Monitoring ensures DR readiness and compliance with data protection SLAs.

useCases.title: Controller Failover Events
useCases.value: Controller failovers indicate hardware problems and may cause transient performance impact. Quick detection ensures rapid root cause analysis.

useCases.title: Thin Provisioning Overcommit
useCases.value: Over-committed thin-provisioned storage can cause sudden outages when physical capacity is exhausted. Monitoring prevents surprise failures.

useCases.title: Snapshot Space Consumption
useCases.value: Runaway snapshot growth can consume all available space, causing volume and application outages.

useCases.title: Fibre Channel Port Errors
useCases.value: FC port errors cause storage performance degradation and potential path failovers. Early detection prevents cascading failures.

useCases.title: Storage Array Firmware Compliance
useCases.value: Outdated firmware exposes arrays to known bugs and security vulnerabilities. Compliance tracking supports patching cadence.

useCases.title: Isilon Cluster and Node Health
useCases.value: Dell EMC Isilon (OneFS) is a scale-out NAS platform. Monitoring node and cluster health ensures availability and early detection of hardware or software issues before data access is impacted.

useCases.title: Isilon Capacity and Performance Trending
useCases.value: Tracks Isilon cluster capacity and throughput (e.g. ops/sec, throughput MB/s) for capacity planning and performance troubleshooting. Matches IT Essentials Learn procedures for Isilon storage.

useCases.title: TrueNAS / FreeNAS Pool Health
useCases.value: ZFS pool degradation, scrub results, and resilver progress directly impact data integrity. Early detection of unhealthy pools prevents data loss and enables timely intervention during rebuilds.

useCases.title: Ceph Cluster Health and OSD Status
useCases.value: Ceph health warnings, OSD down/out events, and placement group (PG) state issues can lead to data unavailability or loss. Monitoring ensures rapid response to cluster degradation.

useCases.title: NFS Export Availability
useCases.value: NFS mount point reachability and latency directly affect application availability. Monitoring from client perspective ensures end-to-end access validation.

useCases.title: SMB / CIFS Share Availability
useCases.value: Windows/SMB share reachability is critical for file-serving workloads. Monitoring ensures shares are accessible before users report issues.

useCases.title: RAID Rebuild Progress and Estimated Completion
useCases.value: During array rebuilds, progress percentage and ETA help plan maintenance and detect stalled rebuilds. Stalled rebuilds increase risk of data loss if another disk fails.

useCases.title: NetApp ONTAP Performance Counters
useCases.value: Counter-based throughput, latency, and queue depth from ONTAP complement volume-level views. Trending counters catches node or aggregate saturation before user-visible latency spikes.

useCases.title: Pure Storage Array Health
useCases.value: Pure FA/FB controller, component, and capacity health events indicate hardware or software risk. Unified visibility supports proactive replacement and support cases.

useCases.title: iSCSI Session Monitoring
useCases.value: Dropped or flapping iSCSI sessions cause path loss and I/O errors. Session count and login state trending validates host-to-array connectivity after network or firmware changes.

useCases.title: Multipath Failover Events
useCases.value: Path failovers indicate cable, SFP, HBA, or array port issues. Rapid detection limits prolonged single-path exposure and data loss risk.

useCases.title: Fibre Channel Port Error Rate (Array)
useCases.value: Array-side FC port CRCs, signal loss, and link failures differ from switch-only views. Port error rate trending isolates HBA/cable issues at the storage attachment point.

useCases.title: LUN Latency Trending
useCases.value: Per-LUN latency separates noisy neighbors and misaligned workloads from array-wide issues. Supports QoS and datastore placement decisions.

useCases.title: Aggregate Space Forecasting
useCases.value: Forecasting aggregate free space prevents sudden write failures on thin-provisioned pools. Supports procurement and volume migration planning.

useCases.title: Snapshot Schedule Compliance
useCases.value: Missed snapshot schedules break backup and rollback expectations. Verifying snapshot recency per policy supports operational and audit requirements.

useCases.title: Deduplication Savings Ratio
useCases.value: Deduplication ratio trending validates efficiency features and detects anomalies (sudden ratio drop may indicate new data types or misconfiguration).

useCases.title: MDS Inter-Switch Link (ISL) Utilization
useCases.value: ISLs carry all inter-switch SAN traffic. Saturated ISLs cause frame queuing, slow drain propagation, and storage latency spikes. Proactive monitoring prevents cascading congestion before hosts see I/…

useCases.title: MDS Slow Drain Detection
useCases.value: Slow drain occurs when a target device (storage or host) cannot accept frames fast enough, exhausting buffer-to-buffer credits and stalling the entire FC path. A single slow-drain device can impact h…

useCases.title: MDS Zone Configuration Compliance
useCases.value: Zoning controls which initiators can communicate with which targets. Misconfigured zones create security risks (unauthorized access) and operational risks (accidental data access). Tracking zone chan…

useCases.title: MDS FLOGI Database Monitoring
useCases.value: The FLOGI (Fabric Login) database records every device that has logged into the SAN fabric. Monitoring FLOGI events detects rogue devices, unexpected host logins, and fabric login storms that indicat…

useCases.title: MDS VSAN Health and Isolation Events
useCases.value: VSANs provide logical SAN segmentation. VSAN isolation events (caused by ISL failures, misconfigured trunking, or merge failures) split the fabric and break host-to-storage paths. Detecting isolation…

useCases.title: MDS SAN Fabric Oversubscription Ratio
useCases.value: The ratio of total edge port bandwidth to ISL bandwidth determines oversubscription. High oversubscription ratios (>7:1 for production, >20:1 for backup) increase the risk of congestion. Tracking thi…

useCases.title: Bucket Capacity Trending
useCases.value: Tracks storage growth for cost forecasting and lifecycle policy effectiveness. Prevents unexpected cloud bills.

useCases.title: Access Pattern Anomalies
useCases.value: Unusual access patterns may indicate data breaches, compromised credentials, or misconfigured applications.

useCases.title: Public Bucket Detection
useCases.value: Public buckets are a top cloud security risk, leading to data breaches. Immediate detection is essential for compliance.

useCases.title: Lifecycle Policy Compliance
useCases.value: Ensures storage cost optimization policies are working. Objects not transitioning per policy waste money.

useCases.title: Cross-Region Replication Lag
useCases.value: Replication lag affects DR readiness. Monitoring ensures geo-redundant data meets RPO requirements.

useCases.title: S3 and Azure Blob Lifecycle Policy Compliance
useCases.value: Confirms lifecycle rules exist per bucket/container and that transitions match tagging/age rules. Reduces cost leakage from objects stuck in hot tiers.

useCases.title: Cross-Region Replication Lag (SLA)
useCases.value: Tracks replication backlog and oldest replicated object age for S3 CRR and Azure geo-replication. Complements byte-level lag with time-based SLA views.

useCases.title: Bucket Policy Change Audit
useCases.value: Unexpected bucket policy or IAM policy changes can expose data. Audit trail supports SOC2/PCI evidence and fast rollback.

useCases.title: Pre-Signed URL Abuse Detection
useCases.value: Unusual volume of pre-signed GET/PUT or access from unexpected IPs may indicate credential theft or insider abuse.

useCases.title: Storage Class Transition Tracking
useCases.value: Validates that objects move to IA/Glacier/Archive per policy. Stalled transitions indicate rule gaps or unsupported objects.

useCases.title: Object Versioning Compliance
useCases.value: Buckets without versioning risk unrecoverable overwrites. Monitoring ensures critical buckets remain versioned per data policy.

useCases.title: Object Lock Integrity
useCases.value: WORM/immutability protects against ransomware and deletion. Verifies Object Lock retention mode and legal hold on regulated buckets.

useCases.title: Backup Job Success Rate
useCases.value: Failed backups leave systems unprotected. Tracking success rate ensures recoverability and compliance with data protection policies.

useCases.title: Backup Job Duration Trending
useCases.value: Increasing backup durations signal data growth, network congestion, or storage performance issues. Prevents backup window overruns.

useCases.title: Missed Backup Detection
useCases.value: A backup that doesn't run at all is worse than one that fails — it's invisible. Detection ensures no system is left unprotected.

useCases.title: Backup Storage Capacity
useCases.value: Running out of backup repository space causes all backup jobs to fail. Proactive monitoring prevents cascading failures.

useCases.title: Restore Test Tracking
useCases.value: Backups are worthless if restores fail. Tracking restore tests ensures confidence in recoverability and satisfies audit requirements.

useCases.title: Backup SLA Compliance
useCases.value: Consolidated view of backup coverage and RPO/RTO compliance. Essential for management reporting and audit evidence.

useCases.title: Backup Data Volume Trending
useCases.value: Tracks data growth rate for capacity planning of backup infrastructure. Identifies unexpected data surges early.

useCases.title: Tape Library Health
useCases.value: Tape media and drive failures can silently corrupt backups. Monitoring ensures long-term archival reliability.

useCases.title: Veeam Backup Job Monitoring
useCases.value: Job success/failure/warning status, duration, and data transferred are essential for backup reliability. Immediate visibility into job outcomes ensures data protection SLAs are met and enables rapid…

useCases.title: Backup Data Growth Rate
useCases.value: Backup repository consumption trending enables capacity planning and prevents surprise exhaustion. Proactive forecasting supports budget and procurement decisions.

useCases.title: Veeam Backup Job Status Summary
useCases.value: Roll-up of last job result per workload (Success/Warning/Failed/Running) for executive and NOC dashboards. Complements session-level detail with a single row per protected entity.

useCases.title: Commvault Job Completion
useCases.value: Failed or incomplete Commvault backup jobs leave subclients unprotected. Job-level success tracking is required for audit and restore confidence.

useCases.title: Backup RPO and RTO Compliance
useCases.value: Compares actual backup completion time and restore test duration against business RPO/RTO targets per application tier.

useCases.title: Tape Library Robotics and Drive Health
useCases.value: Mechanical faults, barcode read errors, and drive cleaning states cause failed backups before media errors. Dedicated robotics metrics reduce MTTR for tape operations.

useCases.title: DR Rehearsal Tracking
useCases.value: Tabletop and technical DR tests must occur on schedule. Tracking rehearsal outcomes and dates supports audit and readiness scoring.

useCases.title: Backup Window Utilization
useCases.value: Jobs that consume most of the backup window risk overlap with production or fail to finish. Utilization % guides schedule tuning and parallel job limits.

useCases.title: Incremental Backup Chain Integrity
useCases.value: Broken increment chains (missing full or corrupted metadata) make restores impossible. Vendor-specific checks detect chain gaps before a failure at restore time.

useCases.title: Backup Data Growth Trending by Workload
useCases.value: Per-workload front-end bytes backed up trend identifies data sprawl, VM growth, or unexpected database growth before repository exhaustion.

useCases.title: Windows Backup Job Monitoring
useCases.value: Windows Server Backup failures mean the server has no recovery point. Silent failures create a false sense of protection.

useCases.title: Backup Target Capacity and Growth Rate
useCases.value: Backup destination (disk, dedup appliance, object storage) that fills up causes backup failures and retention gaps. Tracking growth and remaining capacity prevents surprise outages.

useCases.title: Restore Job Success and Duration Trending
useCases.value: Restore failures or abnormally long restores indicate corrupt backups, network issues, or misconfiguration. Tracking ensures recovery procedures are validated and RTO is achievable.

useCases.title: Backup Job Overlap and Schedule Conflict Detection
useCases.value: Overlapping full backups or too many concurrent jobs overload the backup infrastructure and extend backup windows. Detecting overlap supports schedule tuning and resource sizing.

useCases.title: Immutable Backup and Ransomware Recovery Readiness
useCases.value: Immutable or air-gapped copies are the last line of defense against ransomware. Verifying immutability and recovery procedure readiness ensures backups cannot be deleted or encrypted by an attacker.

useCases.title: Tape Library Slot Utilization
useCases.value: Tape library capacity and media expiration tracking prevent backup failures when slots are exhausted or tapes expire. Supports capacity planning and media lifecycle management.

useCases.title: File Access Audit
useCases.value: Provides full audit trail of file access for compliance (SOX, HIPAA, PCI-DSS). Enables investigation of data breaches and unauthorized access.

useCases.title: Ransomware Indicator Detection
useCases.value: Ransomware causes mass file encryption in minutes. Detecting the pattern early can limit damage by triggering automated isolation.

useCases.title: DFS Replication Health
useCases.value: DFS-R backlog and conflicts indicate replication failures that can lead to data inconsistency and user complaints.

useCases.title: Share Permission Changes
useCases.value: Unauthorized permission changes can expose sensitive data. Change detection supports compliance and security posture.

useCases.title: Large File Transfer Detection
useCases.value: Unusually large file copies may indicate data exfiltration. Detection supports data loss prevention and insider threat programs.

useCases.title: Backup Encryption and Key Access Audit
useCases.value: Backup encryption keys must be used only by authorized backup jobs. Unusual key access or decryption attempts may indicate theft or ransomware. Auditing supports compliance and incident response.

useCases.title: DFS Replication Backlog and Connectivity Health
useCases.value: Backlog size and partner connectivity state predict replication stalls before user-visible file divergence. Complements event-only monitoring with quantitative backlog trending.

useCases.title: NFS Export Capacity and Client Load
useCases.value: Export-level capacity and NFS operations/sec highlight hot exports and approaching full filesystems on NAS heads.

useCases.title: SMB Share Access Audit
useCases.value: Summarizes successful and denied access to sensitive shares for insider threat and access reviews. Extends object-level 4663 views with share-level rollups.

useCases.title: File Server Capacity Trending
useCases.value: Volume-level free space trending on Windows file servers prevents user and application outages from full disks.

useCases.title: Ransomware File Extension Detection
useCases.value: Detects mass renames or creates with known ransomware extensions (e.g., `.locked`, `.encrypted`) faster than generic mass-modify heuristics in some campaigns.

useCases.title: CIFS Connection Monitoring
useCases.value: Tracks concurrent SMB sessions and failed session setups per file server. Spikes may indicate brute force, misconfigured apps, or server resource limits.

useCases.title: File Deletion Volume Anomaly
useCases.value: Sudden spike in delete operations may indicate ransomware preparation, malicious insider, or script error. Complements mass-modify ransomware use cases.
